contrastLab.title: Contrast Lab
contrastLab.description: Pick two colours and see if your text is readable. The lab checks the contrast against WCAG 2.2 and suggests the nearest colour that passes.
contrastLab.imageAlt: The Contrast Lab: a dark red heading on an olive background, colour sliders and a report card with a contrast score of 6.3 to 1

logoMotion.title: 40C3 Logo Motion
logoMotion.description: I'm playing around with the 40C3 logo and trying to make it move with code: typing, glitches, flipping digits and color waves. Some of it works, some of it is not quite there yet.
logoMotion.imageAlt: A green cursor types MODEL_ CITIZENS, then the picture breaks up into shifted stripes and colors and the 40C3 logo takes its place.

citizenLab.title: 40C3 Citizen Lab
citizenLab.description: Somewhere between model citizen and delightful outlier. Build your own citizen for 40C3, then share it as a link or download it as SVG.
citizenLab.imageAlt: A citizen from the Citizen Lab: lilac face, teal hair, pointed ears and earrings

bookshelf.title: Bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Pick a book from my library of 100 feminist books and put it on the shared shelf.
bookshelf.imageAlt: The shared shelf with favorite books and how often each was picked
